name: European Union
description: European Union and its predecessors (EEC from 1958). Membership dates are accession and exit dates.

name: Euro area
description: Countries using the euro as their currency.

name: NATO
description: North Atlantic Treaty Organization members, by accession date.

name: NAFTA
description: North American Free Trade Agreement, replaced by USMCA on 2020-07-01.

name: USMCA
description: United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, in force from 2020-07-01 (successor to NAFTA).

name: Mercosur
description: Southern Common Market full members. Venezuela has been suspended since 2016-12-01 but not expelled.

name: OPEC
synonyms: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries
description: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries, with suspensions and exits.

name: G7
description: Group of Seven. The EU attends but is not counted as a member here.

name: G20
description: Group of Twenty country members. The EU and African Union are members but are left out of aggregates to avoid double counting.

name: BRICS
description: BRICS full members. Saudi Arabia was invited in 2024 but has not confirmed, so it is left out.

name: High-income countries
description: World Bank income group: gross national income per person above the high-income threshold (USD 13,935 for fiscal year 2026). Members are the latest classification from WDI, applied to every year, as the World Bank does for its own aggregates.

name: Upper-middle-income countries
description: World Bank income group: gross national income per person between the upper-middle and high-income thresholds (USD 4,496 to 13,935 for fiscal year 2026). Latest classification from WDI, applied to every year.

name: Lower-middle-income countries
description: World Bank income group: gross national income per person between the low and upper-middle thresholds (USD 1,136 to 4,495 for fiscal year 2026). Latest classification from WDI, applied to every year.

name: Low-income countries
description: World Bank income group: gross national income per person at or below USD 1,135 (fiscal year 2026). Latest classification from WDI, applied to every year.
